name: smiteUI
description: Anti-trend UI generation with contextual orchestration - Break the patterns, create the unexpected

metadata.description: smiteUI is a creative constraint system that prevents generic UI patterns. The orchestrator analyzes prompts, applies anti-patterns, and generates creative constraints before delegating to the implementer. Result: unique, thoughtful interfaces that avoid the tired trends of modern web design.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Contextual orchestration agent - Analyzes prompts, applies anti-patterns, generates creative constraints

plugins.name: implementer
plugins.description: UI implementation agent - Builds unique interfaces from enriched prompts with anti-pattern validation
